schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, COPIES INT, REQUESTOR NVARCHAR(255), QUEUE_DATE DATETIME, PRINT_LOCATION INT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (FILE_NUMBER NVARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, CORRESPONDENCE_ID INT, DOCUMENT_ID INT, INDEX ix_document_id_file_number (DOCUMENT_ID, FILE_NUMBER))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, COPIES, REQUESTOR, QUEUE_DATE, PRINT_LOCATION) SELECT n, n, n % 10, CONCAT('Requestor_', n), DATEADD(DAY, -n % 30, GETDATE()), n % 3 FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers

INSERT INTO CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (FILE_NUMBER, CORRESPONDENCE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID) SELECT CONCAT('File_', n), n, n % 5000 FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers

tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution of FILE_NUMBER and DOCUMENT_ID.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 dc.DOCUMENT_ID, dc.COPIES, dc.REQUESTOR, dc.D_ID, cj.FILE_NUMBER FROM DOCUMENT_QUEUE dc JOIN CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL cj ON dc.DOCUMENT_ID = cj.DOCUMENT_ID WHERE dc.QUEUE_DATE <= GETDATE() AND dc.PRINT_LOCATION = 2 ORDER BY cj.FILE_NUMBER
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the query plan exhibits row goal optimization with nested loops and spooling.
expected_evidence: Nested Loops join with spooling in the plan.
